provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF artifacts, agent-session tool_call events, release docs, and runtime audits are canonical; chat text is not release evidence

event_summaries.summary: Heartbeat required AOF to continue the roadmap using latest runtime and trend context.
AOF runtime selected v11.9 as tool governance replay after v11.8.
Mission Control schema, visibility export, viewer display, release docs, and evidence artifacts were added.
visibility-export projected tool_governance_replay from the current agent-session tool_call stream.
Role outputs and Council review framed v11.9 as bounded recorded tool governance replay, not proof of production safety.
Tool governance replay must not be misread as semantic truth, credential safety, production execution safety, or absence of unrecorded tool calls.
Stop release if v11.9 claims production safety or unrecorded tool-call absence.

risk_candidates: tool governance replay may be mistaken for complete tool-call capture
decision_candidates: advance to v12.0 only after v11.9 proves recorded tool governance replay

redaction_boundary: summaries only; no secrets, credentials, private provider payload bodies, or private transcript content exported
release_ready_boundary: release-ready requires runtime audits, tests, smoke, and CI/tag validation, not this export alone
not_proven: Session export proves traceability for v11.9 release work only; it does not prove semantic truth, production safety, productivity gain, adoption, or unrecorded tool-call absence.
